Biography & Summary

Marvin Raaijmakers is a researcher in the Edge AI research group at the University of Innsbruck focusing on Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, Foundation Models, Algorithms.

Audi AG & CARIAD SE (latter from 2022) (Ingolstadt, Germany)

Research-like development of algorithms for environment perception and scene understanding at the pre-development department for automated driving system of Audi AG/CARIAD SE.
